The '''Mestra system''', in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]], contained no [[Planet/Legends|planets]] but had one of the most expansive [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid fields]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Javis-12]]. At least some of the asteroids on Mestra hosted [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations. Though no accurate count had ever been made, it was estimated that there were at least 100 ''trillion'' sizable chunks of rock in the system, hundreds of them the size of small [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. The Mestra system had some of the richest deposits of [[Durelium/Legends|durelium]] ore, one of the more valuable metals in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], for it was essential in the construction of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]]. All mining operations in the Mestra system were controlled and managed by the [[Minos-Mestra Corporation]], a company that [[VernanGroup]] sold to local investors after the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Corporation owned a number of [[Smelting ship|smelting ships]], whose crew the independent [[Miner/Legends|miners]] of the system derogatory called "[[Poundies]]".<ref name="GG6" />

The Javis-12 [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was the only asteroid in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] with any sort of [[Portable beacon|landing beacon]] or starport. Javis-12 also had the only [[Starship/Legends|ship]] repair and refuel services available in the system (for which the charge was an even 200 percent of list price). The Javis-12 spaceport consisted of a series of domes and caves on one of the largest asteroids in the system. Javis-12 was roughly egg-shaped, and about 400 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] across. It was located on the edge of the asteroid belt. All spin had been taken off of the rock, and the spaceport faced directly away from the belt, making it fairly safe from asteroid hits.<ref name="GG6" />

The [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Vegath Tist]] was forced to work as a miner in the system during a period of indentured servitude. He eventually fled the mines with anything he could steal at the time.<ref name="TDC">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the children of enriched [[Miner/Legends|miners]] from Mestra had founded a secret society called '[[The Vigil (Mestra system)|The Vigil]]'<ref name="GG6" />, which hosted its meetings in the system.

==Behind the scenes==
On page 67 of [[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]] the system is erroneously spelled as 'Mesta' The name was later corrected in [[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)|the Second Edition]]
